shasum -a 256 outputs/v3/preview.png outputs/v3/hero_detail_v3.svg outputs/v3/design_document.json outputs/v3/change_set.json outputs/v3/ambient_background_v0.png outputs/v3/product_reference_locked.png outputs/v3/render_preview.m outputs/project-state.json
python3 - <<'"'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from copy import deepcopy
v1=Image.open('outputs/v1/preview.png').convert('RGB')
v2=Image.open('outputs/v2/preview.png').convert('RGB')
v3=Image.open('outputs/v3/preview.png').convert('RGB')
d=ImageChops.difference(v2,v3)
print('v2_v3_diff_bbox=',d.getbbox())
print('v2_v3_diff_pixels=',sum(p"'!=(0,0,0) for p in d.getdata()))
allowed=(538,1199,1002,1367)
mask=Image.new('"'RGB',v2.size); mask.paste(d.crop(allowed),allowed)
print('diff_outside_allowed_bbox=',ImageChops.difference(d,mask).getbbox())
print('v1_v3_pixel_equal=',ImageChops.difference(v1,v3).getbbox() is None)
a=ET.parse('outputs/v2/hero_detail_v2.svg').getroot(); b=ET.parse('outputs/v3/hero_detail_v3.svg').getroot()
for oid in ['ambient-background','product-stage','product-image-locked','headline-block','headline','headline-accent','feature-low-noise','bottom-rhythm']:
 ea=a.find(f\".//*[@id='{oid}']\"); eb=b.find(f\".//*[@id='{oid}']\")
 print('object_equal',oid,ET.tostring(ea)==ET.tostring(eb))
def canonical(node):
 n=deepcopy(node)
 for e in n.iter():
  e.tail=None
  if e.text is not None and not e.text.strip(): e.text=None
 for k in ['transform','data-slot','data-delta-y']:
  n.attrib.pop(k,None)
 return ET.tostring(n)
for oid in ['feature-timer','feature-clay-touch']:
 print('content_style_equal_after_ignoring_slot_transform',oid,canonical(a.find(f\".//*[@id='{oid}']\"))==canonical(b.find(f\".//*[@id='{oid}']\")))
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
print('v2_font_sizes=',[(e.get('id'),e.get('font-size')) for e in a.findall('.//s:text',ns)])
print('v3_font_sizes=',[(e.get('id'),e.get('font-size')) for e in b.findall('.//s:text',ns)])
print('v3_visual_order=',[(e.get('id'),''.join(e.itertext())) for e in b.findall('.//s:text',ns)])
print('v3_third_transform=',b.find(\".//*[@id='feature-clay-touch']\").get('transform'))
PY"
